newsitem.title: DENMARK: FORECAST - Lower Unidanmark 96 profit seen.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Lower Unidanmark 96 profit seen.

text.p: Analysts polled by Reuters in a survey released on Monday forecast on average slightly lower full year 1996 pre-tax profits for Denmark's second biggest bank Unidanmark than in 1995.

Eight international and domestic analysts forecast average profits before tax and extraordinary items of 2.912 billion crowns for Unidanmark in 1996, compared to 2.955 billion crowns in the previous year.
Unidanmark is due to announce its 1996 results on Wednesday February 19, while other banks release their results during the following days.

Last August, Unidanmark posted group pre-tax and extraordinary items profits of 1.264 billion crowns, compared to 1995's interim 1.158 billion crown surplus and said it expected a lower second half 1996 result.
Analysts expect falling average profits for all Denmark's four leading banks for 1996.
